methods.label: Compare the theorem statements
methods.explanation: An inscribed angle is half the central angle subtending the same arc. Inscribed angles subtending the same chord may lie on opposite sides of the chord and be supplementary, so they are not necessarily equal. Inscribed angles subtending the same arc or equal arcs are equal.
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 9 inscribed angle theorem and the elementary meaning of supplementary angles.
